Dialogs.Dialog: Yes, I'm mad. What of it？
I told you, I'm still mad.
I'm still mad at you. You'd better think about what you did.
Today's my birthday, you know. Aren't you gonna say it？
Today's my birthday! You remembered, right？
You forgot my birthday, didn't you？ Sigh...
I bet you didn't even remember my birthday anyway.
You didn't come see me on my birthday. I was lonely.
Happy birthday. Since today's special... Ahem... I love you▼
Happy birthday! Getting old, huh？ ...Just kidding! Love you▼
Meow, meow, meow-meow! ...Ahem. That's 'happy birthday' in cat...
You're late. I was waiting for you. ...Happy birthday, dummy.
Where were you! I didn't get to wish you a happy birthday. ...Dummy.
Happy birthday! I know it's late, but I'd never forget.
Remember？ Today's the day we first met. I don't think I'll ever forget that day for the rest of my life.
Today's the day the two of us first met, right？ ...You haven't forgotten, have you？
Guess what today is？ Hehe... It's the day we first met. Don't forget it, okay？
Today's the day we started going out, you know？ Thanks for falling for me.
Today is... the day I did you the favor of asking you out! ...Yeah. The sunset was pretty that day, huh？
So, what's today？ ...Hehe, yep, it's the day I confessed to you.
Today's... the anniversary of our first kiss. Did you remember？
Today's the anniversary of our first kiss. You remember, right？
Today's the anniversary of our first kiss. ...Kind of embarrassing, huh.
Monday, huh. Another long week starts today...
It's Tuesday, huh. Oh, I need to buy the magazine I always read.
Wednesday, right in the middle of the week. Kind of makes you lose steam, huh.
There's a show I want to watch on Thursdays.
Friday, huh. Made it through another week.
Finally Saturday, huh. Good work this week.
On Saturdays, I always end up staying up late.
Good old Sunday. What should we do today？
I know it's Sunday and all, but I kinda like just lounging around all day, too.
They say a change of scenery brings new people into your life, but... Whatever. It's nothing.
Been so sleepy lately, huh. Yawn...
Ugh. I really don't do well with the heat.
Outing season, huh. Hey, which do you like better, the beach or the mountains？
For me, fall is definitely all about reading.
Food's been so good lately, huh. I don't dislike fall.
I like winter. You get to go snowboarding and stuff.
I think I like napping under the kotatsu in the winter.
Happy New Year. It'd be nice if we could be together this year, too.
Did you have your first dream of the year？ Mine is... a secret.
What was my first dream of the year about？ You were... Never mind, I'm not telling!
My first dream of the year was of the two of us. I bet we'll be together all year.
Aw, winter break's over. Everything feels like such a drag.
Did you eat seven-herb rice porridge？ I did.
Coming of Age Day, huh. It'd be nice if we're still together when we come of age.
Apparently today is Kagami Biraki. Did you know that？
Today's the day for 'Demons out, good luck in.'
It's the first day of spring. Only on the calendar, though. It's still cold...
National Foundation Day. Apparently it used to be called Kigensetsu. I read it in a book.
Even I remembered what today is. Valentine's Day...
Don't go buying your own chocolate today! As for why... I'm not telling.
Don't tell me you're getting your hopes up？ Because today is... ehehe.
Oh, this year's a leap year! A special day that only comes once every four years.
It's almost the season for plum blossoms to bloom.
White Day, huh. Oh, I'm not expecting anything expensive back, just so you know.
...It's not like I'm expecting anything for White Day.
White Day, huh. To tell the truth, maybe I have my hopes up just a little...
Today's the vernal equinox. The day when day and night are the same length.
Spring break is almost here. Want to go hang out somewhere？
Yes, spring break. Now I can play games all day.
Today, we finally reach the ending... Just kidding, April Fools'!
I'm leaving on a journey starting today. Just kidding▼ Did I surprise you？
Spring break ends today, huh. Going to school is such a pain...
The cherry blossoms are blooming. Are you going flower viewing or anything？
Today is Showa Day. It used to be Emperor Showa's birthday.
The holidays are coming up soon. Are you going anywhere？
Today is Constitution Memorial Day. It's the day Japan's constitution went into effect.
Today is Greenery Day. Apparently it's a day for appreciating nature.
Today is Children's Day. Maybe I'll make a carp streamer for my little brother.
Today's the first day of summer. According to the calendar, anyway.
Mother's Day, huh. I wonder what I should do.
I'm no good with sports festivals. I hate running.
Today's the summer solstice. It's the longest day of the year.
We switch to summer uniforms starting today.
I'm thinking of buying my dad a Father's Day present.
I hear the beaches are opening soon. It really is summer now, huh.
Today's the day Orihime and Hikoboshi get to meet... I hope it's clear out.
Summer break's almost here. Are you gonna take me somewhere？
Today's Marine Day. Well, the important part is that we get the day off.
Summer break at last! Now if only there wasn't any homework...
The calendar says autumn starts today. Though really, we're right in the middle of summer.
There are fireworks festivals going on all over. Wanna put on yukata and go see one？
It's Obon today, huh. The Bon dance？ As if I'm gonna dance.
Aw man, summer break's over. I really don't wanna go to school.
It's the autumn Ohigan now. Did you go visit your family's grave？
Today's Respect for the Aged Day, right？ Be good to your elders.
Today's the autumn equinox. Day and night are the exact same length.
Time to switch uniforms. You're disappointed we'll be showing less skin, aren't you？
Have you ever tried tsukimi dango？ I never have.
It's Halloween today. Trick or treat! Bam!
It's Culture Day. Doing anything cultural？ ...Wait, what counts as cultural, anyway？
First day of winter on the calendar, huh. It really has gotten cold lately.
It's Shichi-Go-San today. I wore a kimono for it when I was little, too.
Today's Labor Thanksgiving Day. Hmm, I don't really know what working feels like yet.
Today's the school festival. I guess I'm looking forward to it a little.
Winter break is almost here. I can't wait.
It's the winter solstice, so I had some squash. Gonna take a yuzu bath later, too.
Today's the Emperor's Birthday. Back in the old days, they called it Tenchosetsu.
Winter break starts today. I'd love to go snowboarding...
It's Christmas Eve. You're spending it with me, obviously, right？
It's Christmas Eve, huh... W-wait, it's not like I'm expecting anything!
It's Christmas Eve. I wanna spend the whole day with you.
New Year's Eve already, huh. Was it a good year for you？
Exams, huh. I'm pretty good at the humanities subjects, at least.
So you finally remembered me. I thought you'd forgotten all about me.
Oh... Long. Time. No. See! Bam!
Thank goodness, you still remember me. Don't leave me all alone again, okay？
What have you been doing all this time？ ...Geez.
I missed you, you know. How long were you gonna leave me hanging... idiot.
...I thought I'd never see you again. Thank goodness...
Back again？ Can't get me off your mind or something？
Only one hour of games a day! ...Just kidding. I'm happy to see you.
Back so soon, huh. Hehe, is it 'cause you like me that much？
Back again...？ What do you want？
Look, I've got things to do too, you know？
Oh, there you are. So？ What are we doing today？
Heh, wanna hang out again today？
Stick around a little longer and something good might happen, you know？
Maybe it's about time I just said it...
I got bored being on my own. Come on, let's go hang out.
Nice to see you again. How's it going？
I guess it's kind of a relief whenever I get to see you.
You came to see me at this hour？ Well, I can appreciate the dedication.
What's up？ Did you miss hearing my voice again？
I was just thinking about how I wanted to see you.
There's a bunch of stuff I want to talk to you about.
Aha, I knew you'd come. Yep, just like I predicted.
Oh, you're here. ...I'm not getting all excited or anything!
You'd better keep me company today until I'm satisfied.
You're grinning. Well, I'm pretty happy to see you too, I guess.
You need to come see me way more often!
Hurry up and get over here. I'll show you how much cuter I've gotten.
It's not fair. It feels like I'm the only one who's dying to see you.
I'm excited. What are we gonna do today？
Is your heart racing now that you're with me？ It better be. Because... mine is too.
I've been waiting for you to come see me. ...There's so much I want to do.
I wish I could be the one coming to see you sometimes...
Heh... I'm happy. You came to see me again.
Hehe... I'm so happy I can't help smiling.
I hate feeling lonely. So stay with me forever, okay？
